notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 106–568, title VI, § 602, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2906, which set out congressional findings and purpose, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 106–568, title VI, § 601, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2906, provided that title VI of Pub. L. 106–568, enacting this subchapter and provisions formerly set out as a note under this section, could be cited as the “Torres-Martinez Desert Cahuilla Indians Claims Settlement Act”.

ancestors.heading: TORRES-MARTINEZ DESERT CAHUILLA INDIANS CLAIMS SETTLEMENT
